result.summary: Adds a test case to the p2p_sendheaders functional test to verify that receiving an unconnecting headers message alone does not reset the node's getheaders rate limit timer. The test confirms that no new getheaders request is dispatched immediately, but one is sent once mocktime is advanced past the rate limit timeout.
result.problem: Existing test coverage in p2p_sendheaders always sent an empty headers message prior to an unconnecting header, masking whether an unconnecting header alone correctly leaves m_last_getheaders_timestamp unmodified as intended since commit 9f66ac7cf1.
evidence: PR description notes that existing tests missed this case because 'Part 5 of p2p_sendheaders always sends an empty headers message before each unconnecting header'
Kills mutant 3744 on MutantHub according to the PR description
result.card: Adds a test in p2p_sendheaders.py verifying that unconnecting headers messages do not reset the node's getheaders rate limit. Existing functional tests sent an empty headers message first, leaving untracked behavior when an unconnecting header arrives alone. The change improves test coverage by killing a known mutant in P2P header processing logic.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause a functional test failure or false positive in CI.
